issues: Claim of 5 turnovers won in last 5 minutes contradicts fact of only 3 turnovers won last 5 minutes

Claim that Ashvale Rovers won 5 turnovers in the last 5 minutes contradicts fact high_turnovers_last5 which is 3

issues: Claim that Ashvale Rovers hold a numerical advantage with 11 players against 10 is misleading; facts confirm Ashvale Rovers have 11 players and Kestrel Bay FC 10, but the claim implies this advantage is current and ongoing without noting the red card timing explicitly.

Claim that Ashvale Rovers' pressing has increased turnovers won to 8 in the last 5 minutes is not supported; facts show 8 turnovers won last 5 minutes but no evidence that pressing caused the increase.

Headline 'Ashvale Rovers Intensify Press Despite Even Score' implies a pressing surge despite the score, but facts show possession last 5 minutes at 62.2%, pressures last 5 at 17, and turnovers won 8, which supports pressing intensity; however, the story's causal language about pressing being the catalyst to break deadlock is speculative and should be softened.

cards.title: Yaw Mensah-Cole scores
cards.headline: Mensah-Cole's late strike puts Ashvale ahead
cards.story: Yaw Mensah-Cole scores his third goal with a precise finish from close range, putting Ashvale Rovers 3-2 ahead. Despite Kestrel Bay FC's numerical disadvantage and balanced contest, Ashvale's sustained pressure and higher shot count prove decisive in this crucial late moment.

cards.title: Ashvale Rovers turn up the press
cards.headline: Ashvale Rovers press hard to protect lead
cards.story: With a one-player advantage and 3-2 lead, Ashvale Rovers ramp up pressing, winning 10 turnovers in the last five minutes. Despite a contested tempo and high chaos, their overwhelming presence disrupts Kestrel Bay’s attempts to equalise late on, helping maintain control in a tense finish.

issues: Claim of 65.5% possession in last five minutes contradicts fact showing 51.0% home possession and 49.0% away possession overall, with no separate last 5 minutes split for teams.

Claim that Ashvale Rovers have 'overwhelming influence' conflicts with 'pulse_tempo' being 'contested' and 'pulse_dominance_strength' as 'overwhelming'—the combination is contradictory and needs clarification.
